Source-checked stair labels

33 stair boxes in 32 positive patches and 21 negative patches across eight supplied SE12/SW3 floors. Red boxes show visible stair assemblies. Checked visually by Codex (AI); not human or field verified. These selected patches are completely annotated for the single stair class; whole floors are NOT completely annotated. No routes or weights changed.

F1/F2: train; F3: validation; F4: reserved evaluation. Earlier diagnostic exposure means evaluation is not a pristine unseen-building benchmark. Shared stair layouts across floors can inflate results.
